requirements.quote: Bidder/Offerer certifies that it understands and agrees to comply with the procedures of the Syracuse Regional Airport Authority relative to permissible contacts as required by State Finance Law Section 139-j (3) and Section 139-j (6) (b).
requirements.text: Bidder must comply with permissible contact procedures per State Finance Law.

requirements.quote: Has any governmental entity made a finding of non-responsibility regarding the individual or entity seeking to enter into this procurement contract in the previous four years?
requirements.text: Bidder must disclose any findings of non-responsibility in the past four years.

requirements.quote: Was the basis for the finding of non-responsibility due to a violation of State Finance Law §139-j?
requirements.text: Bidder must disclose if non-responsibility was due to State Finance Law §139-j violation.

requirements.quote: If “Yes,” was the basis for the finding of non-responsibility due to the intentional provision of false or incomplete information to a governmental entity?
requirements.text: Bidder must disclose if non-responsibility was due to false or incomplete information.

requirements.quote: If “Yes” to any of the above questions, please provide details regarding the finding of non-responsibility: Governmental Entity: _______________________________________ Date of Finding of Non-Responsibility: _________________________ Basis of Finding of Non-Responsibility (attach additional sheets as necessary)
requirements.text: Bidder must provide details of any findings of non-responsibility.

requirements.quote: Has any governmental entity terminated or withheld a procurement contract with the above-named individual or entity due to the intentional provision of false or incomplete information?
requirements.text: Bidder must disclose if any contracts were terminated or withheld due to false or incomplete information.

requirements.quote: If “Yes” to the above question, provide details: Governmental Entity: _________________________________________________________________________ Date of Termination or Withholding of Contract: ___________________________________________________ Basis of Termination or Withholding: (add additional pages if necessary)
requirements.text: Bidder must provide details of any contract terminations or withholdings.

requirements.quote: Bidder/Offerer certifies that all information provided to the Syracuse Regional Airport Authority with respect to State Finance Law Section 139-k is complete, true, and accurate.
requirements.text: Bidder must certify the accuracy and completeness of information provided under State Finance Law Section 139-k.
